problems.title: Kinetic penalty doubled relative to defined JKO step
problems.claim: Eq. (6), optimized by Algorithm 3, implements the JKO objective in Eq. (5) at the same stated step size.
problems.location: PDF pp. 5-6, Eqs. (5)-(7); p. 23 Algorithm 3; src/train.py lines 87-104; src/CNF_utils.py ODEfunc.forward
problems.assumptions: Positive step size; exact Gaussian mean family; CNF duration 1 in the preserved code; omega accumulates squared velocity with no hidden half.
problems.counterevidence: The parameter reinterpretation tau_eff=tau/2 preserves a JKO family and may preserve convergence and practical performance. This does not validate the printed derivation; benchmark harm is not claimed.
problems.impact: A false derivation directly changes the central neural-JKO training objective and its exact optimizer at the same stated tau; this core dependency supports Major.
problems.correction: Use omega/2 or explicitly reconcile all equations and time parameters with tau_eff=tau/2. Scalar correspondence verified; complete theory/code repair unverified.
